# Claude Code Models Providers

Each cloud provider uses its own names for the same models.
An alias such as `opus` is a short name that Claude Code turns into the right model for your provider.
For example, on Amazon Bedrock the alias `sonnet` means `claude-sonnet-4-5`, so set `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL` to use a newer one.

## About the Lists

Source: the `provider_ids`, `vertex_region_env_var`, and `aliases` parts of the model catalog (see [Models Catalog](Claude-Code-Models-Catalog)).
A row has the mark ✅ when a docs page names the model, such as [Amazon Bedrock](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/amazon-bedrock) or [Model Configuration](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config).
It has the mark 🔍 when only the bundle has the names.
The aliases are documented in [Model Configuration](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config).

## Providers

The bundle knows these provider keys: `first_party`, `bedrock`, `vertex`, `foundry`, `anthropic_aws`, `anthropic_google_cloud`, `mantle`, and `gateway`.
These env vars choose the provider:

| Env var | Mark | Provider |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK` | ✅ | Amazon Bedrock. |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX` | ✅ | Google Cloud Agent Platform (Vertex). |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_FOUNDRY` | ✅ | Microsoft Foundry. |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_MANTLE` | ✅ | The Mantle endpoint of Amazon Bedrock. |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_ANTHROPIC_AWS` | ✅ | Claude Platform on AWS. |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_GATEWAY` | 🔍 | A gateway, which also needs `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` and a token. |

Source: [Environment Variables](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/env-vars) and the bundle.
The Anthropic API, `anthropic_aws`, `anthropic_google_cloud`, and `gateway` providers use the first-party names, so the table leaves them out.

[Environment Variables](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/env-vars) lists them.

## Aliases

An alias is a short name for the newest model of a family.
The catalog holds `opus`, `sonnet`, `haiku`, and `fable`, and the help text of `--model` names `fable`, `opus`, and `sonnet`.
The catalog has no aliases for old names and no default model.

| Alias | Mark | Default model | Exceptions |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `opus` | ✅ | `claude-opus-5-5` | Foundry uses `claude-opus-4-6`, and gateways use `claude-opus-4-7`. |
| `sonnet` | ✅ | `claude-sonnet-5-5` | Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, and Mantle use `claude-sonnet-4-5`, and Claude Platform on AWS and gateways use `claude-sonnet-4-6`. |
| `haiku` | ✅ | `claude-haiku-5-5` | Every other provider uses `claude-haiku-4-5`. |
| `fable` | ✅ | `claude-fable-5-1` | Gateways use `claude-fable-5`. |

Source: [Model Configuration](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config) for the aliases, and the bundle for the exceptions.
